The task is complete. I've created a **closed chain of 10 identical circular ellipses** in Excalidraw:

✅ **10 circles** — arranged evenly around a large ring (36° apart)
✅ **Identical size** — each circle is 120×120 (a perfect circle/ellipse)
✅ **Linked by overlapping** — each circle overlaps its two neighbors, forming interlocked links
✅ **Closed chain** — the ring closes completely; the last circle overlaps back to the first, so it's a continuous loop
✅ **Stroke color exactly #C0C0C0** (silver) — verified in the hex code field showing `c0c0c0` for all selected elements
✅ **Transparent background** — so the overlapping/linking is clearly visible

The result is a nice silver circular chain necklace-like pattern. Each of the 10 circles connects to its neighbors through overlap, and there are no gaps — it's a truly closed circular chain.
